user.title: Dimplex Hub
user.description:
Unofficial integration — not affiliated with or supported by Dimplex. It uses the same private cloud API as the official app, discovered by reverse-engineering it, so Dimplex may change or break it without notice.

Choose your preferred authentication method.

credentials.title: Sign in with email
credentials.description: Enter your Dimplex account email and password to sign in automatically.

auth_code.title: Manual auth code
auth_code.description:
Open this URL in a browser: {auth_url}

Log in, then capture the redirect URL (or just the `code` parameter) from the browser's address bar or DevTools network tab. Paste it below.

reauth.title: Re-authenticate Dimplex Hub
reauth.description: Your authentication has expired. Choose a method to sign in again.

reauth_auth_code.title: Re-authenticate with auth code
reauth_auth_code.description:
Open this URL in a browser: {auth_url}

Log in, capture the redirect URL/code, and paste it below.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Dimplex service.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance is allowed.
abort.already_configured: This Dimplex account is already configured.
abort.reauth_account_mismatch: That is a different Dimplex account to the one this entry was set up with.

reauth_required.title: Dimplex Hub needs reauthentication
reauth_required.description: The cloud session expired or was rejected. Open the integration and complete reauthentication (email/password or auth code).

empty_energy_season.title: No energy telemetry this season
empty_energy_season.description: Energy polls succeed but return no history points. This is common in summer when heaters are idle. Sensors stay unavailable until the cloud reports daily kWh again.

empty_overview.title: All appliances unavailable
empty_overview.description: The hub was found but appliance overview is empty. Check power, network, and the official Dimplex app.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the Dimplex cloud to control {target}. The service may be temporarily unavailable; nothing was changed.

control_rejected.message: The Dimplex cloud rejected this control for {target}. The appliance may not support it remotely — some Quantum storage heaters reject off/setpoint changes — so retrying will not help.

cylinder_unavailable.message: That hot-water cylinder is not available right now.

holiday_end_in_past.message: The holiday end must be in the future.

missing_target.message: The dimplex action requires a device_id or entity_id.

no_appliance_on_device.message: Could not resolve an appliance id from device {device_id}.

no_appliance_on_entity.message: Could not resolve an appliance id from service target {entity_id}.

no_loaded_entry.message: No loaded Dimplex entry for {entry_id}; cannot resolve appliance {appliance_id}.

profile_on_cylinder.message: {name} is a hot-water cylinder; heating profiles apply to room-heater timer schedules, so {target} was not sent.

profile_target_required.message: Give exactly one of {id_key} or {name_key} to {target}.

schedule_copy_different_hub.message: Every target appliance must be on the same hub as the source; no schedule was copied.

schedule_copy_unresolved.message: Could not resolve {target_device_id} as a Dimplex appliance; no schedule was copied.

schedule_period_not_found.message: {name} has no schedule period starting {start_time} on {day}. Check that appliance's Schedule sensor for its actual periods — this action edits an existing period, it does not create one.

unknown_appliance.message: Could not resolve appliance {appliance_id} as a Dimplex appliance; check the target and try again.

unsupported_control.message: {name} does not support this control ({capability} is false for it), so {target} was not sent.
